H6's 640-parameter detached soft-state boundary-query residual was trained under the frozen recipe and evaluated once on the sealed development partition. Held-out VALUE COPYING passed its floor (2277/2987, above H5's 2220); all three failures were epistemic-state gates - absence 199/413, conflict 143/250, uncertainty 190/250. The residual traded states (uncertainty +11.2, absence -19.6) rather than lifting them.

Risk-coverage analysis for ternary evidence-bound prediction. Three independent mechanisms in this repo bound risk while leaving coverage unpriced: fabric/slice.py:248 (gate denominated in a system-controlled quantity - a mute verifier scores 0.0% and passes), wedge_v1 _relevant_claim (conjunctive span filter, no coverage term), and minimal_zero_wrong_presented_inclusive_v1 (one-line policy, two operating points, no curve). Fabric's verifier itself is NOT over-abstaining: across all 24 cells withheld=2642=caught_err with lost_correct=0.

On the calibration partition (4000 fields, 120 operating points, AURC 0.00510) the frozen zero-wrong-presented policy retains 538 correct answers at 13.5% coverage, while threshold 0.9747 retains 2831 at 71.1% coverage for 14 errors - accepting 14 errors recovers 2293 correct answers. Diagnostic only: it selects nothing, and does NOT re-litigate H5/H6, which were rejected at the uncalibrated gate before the threshold stage ran.

No current evidence supports clinical deployment or zero-error open-world claims.
The product's over-abstention is not fixed: 3/10 useful on the only real corpus; W-ABSTAIN-2 fixed one mechanism (n=1 in scope, agent-applied labels) and the 2-token conjunction remains open.
The H6 evaluation ran on CPU because Kaggle's P100 is unsupported by the pinned torch build; this is a disclosed hardware delta, not a byte-replication of the 2026-08-03 GPU training.
Rung-1 pretraining has not run; today's evidence indicates the residual copying gap is a finetune-data problem (one slot, five-value pool) rather than a scale problem.
